scope: Only fixed base-v0 Result-typed OpenPreselectedUser import; reuse the complete existing upstream local-user handle producer. No general account IPC implementation, new handle namespace, provider or guest rewrite.

wire_contract.abi: nn::Result OpenPreselectedUser(UserHandle *); low32 Result, one pointer argument. Not the newer TryOpenPreselectedUser bool ABI.
wire_contract.sdk_dependency: Original Open directly consumes private SDK preselected UID/backend object initialized by original SDK Initialize; it does not call TryOpenPreselectedUser. The existing host force initializer/GetUserId instead own one immutable local UID and host token.

implementation.one_owner: Use original write_handle, bound persistent local UID, LOCAL_USER_TOKEN and g_account_user_open. Original ListAllUsers, GetUserId and PopOpenUsers share the same original account state.
implementation.writes: No extra check, temporary handle, memcpy, identity read or atomic state. Existing try_open rejects NULL/uninitialized before writing; write_handle uses the existing checked void preparation before its original 24B copy. Failed preparation dies before the copy and open-state store.
implementation.success: The configured one-preselected-local-user path returns existing RES_OK=0 only after original producer succeeds.
implementation.failure: Existing host RES_FAIL=0x2a2 when original bool returns0. This is the existing host policy and is not asserted equal to any particular original SDK failure Result.

rule.name: _ZN2nn7account19OpenPreselectedUserEPNS0_10UserHandleE
rule.why: base-v0 preselected user uses the complete native account handle

limits: Static/owned CPU evidence does not establish which Init caller executed, identify a device fatal site, or prove gameplay.
This adaptation does not create an SDK service object or expose host handles to original SDK account consumers.
Original upstream account body, UID/save binding, generic account IPC, and all other APIs remain unchanged.
